summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Scam-Link Sentinel landing page. 13/14 backend tests pass; all required frontend flows (waitlist x2, scanner with verdict, example chips, threat feed, FAQ accordion, Stripe checkout redirect) work end-to-end. One backend issue: /api/checkout/status/{session_id} returns 500 because the Stripe test session created via emergent SDK cannot be read back through get_checkout_status (Stripe says 'No such checkout.session'). This does not affect the user-facing checkout flow which works (Stripe sandbox UI loads at $4.99 after click).

minor.issue: Returns 500 (CheckoutError: No such checkout.session) when called with a session_id just produced by /api/checkout/session in the same key. emergentintegrations create_checkout_session succeeded and Stripe served the live checkout URL at $4.99, but get_checkout_status cannot find the session. Likely a Stripe test-key/account scoping quirk in the emergent SDK. Verify by either (a) updating server.py to catch CheckoutError and degrade gracefully to the persisted DB record, or (b) confirming with the emergent SDK maintainers whether status retrieval is supported for the emergent test key.

Line 142 contains a dead expression: `if url.startswith('http') and ('//' + d in url or url.endswith(d) for d in SAFE_DOMAINS):` — the generator object is always truthy and `d` is unbound after the prior `any(...)`. Today this still produces correct verdicts because the surrounding `any()` on line 141 handles SAFE matches, but the check is logically broken and should be replaced with `any('//' + d in url or url.endswith(d) for d in SAFE_DOMAINS)`.

action_items: Investigate /api/checkout/status 500 — wrap get_checkout_status in try/except and fall back to the DB-persisted txn record so the post-checkout success page can still render. Alternatively confirm with emergent SDK that the test key supports status retrieval.
Fix the dead generator expression on server.py line 142 (logic bug, currently harmless).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 142: broken generator-in-boolean — fix or remove.
Checkout status endpoint has no error handling for upstream CheckoutError; produces opaque 500 to clients.
All endpoints are well-validated with Pydantic, MongoDB _id correctly excluded, env vars used everywhere, data-testids present on every interactive element — good baseline.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in app. STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent already in /app/backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: Test waitlist emails prefixed TEST_ created during test runs (idempotent on rerun). Payment_transactions row created per Stripe test session — non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py is reusable as regression suite. Only one test (TestCheckout::test_status) currently fails due to Stripe session retrieval issue described above. Frontend flows all pass; verified that clicking pricing-checkout-button hits POST /api/checkout/session with package_id=founding_member and redirects to a real Stripe sandbox checkout page showing US$4.99. Example chip data-testids are URL-suffixed (e.g. scanner-example-uniswap.org/swap) and only render when scanner has no current result — click them before running a custom scan.
rca of the issue: Checkout status 500: emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.StripeCheckout.get_checkout_status(session_id) raises CheckoutError 'No such checkout.session: cs_test_...' for sessions just created by the same StripeCheckout instance with key sk_test_emergent. Reproduction: POST /api/checkout/session with package_id=founding_member; take returned session_id; GET /api/checkout/status/{session_id} -> 500. Mitigation: try/except around get_checkout_status, return last-known status from db.payment_transactions when the upstream lookup fails (or simply pending). This also makes the success page resilient to Stripe API hiccups.
